scope: Direct assistant comparison of original question and all four options in English, Chinese and Vietnamese. Does not approve source support, evidence translation, or model evaluation.

rows.finding: Mass/weight comparison, quantities and option identities preserved; pound is retained as a unit in Vietnamese and converted to Chinese 磅.
Past climate question and geologic-liquid-water explanation preserved. Vietnamese optionB is awkward but retains the historical observation claim and does not change the keyed option.

Vietnamese optionB translates English too cool as Quá tuyệt (roughly too great/wonderful), losing the temperature meaning. The stem also varies corona terminology, but the temperature mistranslation is the material failure. Do not repair the published option silently.
Rock height5cm, angle0.5degrees, distance query and all meter/foot alternatives preserved. Decimal comma in Vietnamese is an equivalent notation, not numeric corruption.
Sunrise-to-sunrise solar day and all time alternatives preserved. Vietnamese explicitly repeats sunrise and Chinese says next sunrise; neither switches to sidereal rotation.
Hydrogen wavelength comparison486.1to485.9nm and toward/away alternatives preserved. No sign reversal or temperature/motion switch.

Chinese optionB renders Cygnus as 天琴座 (Lyra), instead of 天鹅座. This changes a named distractor even though the published keyed optionC remains Cassiopeia. Exclude for cross-language option inequivalence.

Mass/size question and gravitational-compression option preserved. Chinese optionD uses lower density for less compact; this is an acceptable rendering in the intended density comparison. Source/unique-answer adjudication is separate.

Vietnamese keyed optionA translates Hydrogen as Thủy điện (hydroelectricity), not hydrogen/hiđrô. The stem also uses yếu tố for element. This directly corrupts the answer text and cannot be treated as equivalent.
Perihelion/aphelion order, .304/.456AU and every ratio preserved across all three languages.
